# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional fixes were required in this pass. The latest approved implementation already fixed the legacy process-parameter provenance migration, added explicit provenance/confidence metadata for the remaining decomposer and nitrifier rate/yield/decay controls plus `comammox_vmax_fraction`, documented the fixed `ATMOSPHERIC_CO2_PPM` boundary constant, updated `docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md`, and added regression coverage to keep those annotations and migrations in place.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Reviewed the round-4 validation output and confirmed the review outcome was approved with no follow-up amendments.
1. [Skipped] Skipped further code and data edits because the approved implementation already satisfied the requested provenance fixes for the priority parameter families and the remaining gaps are documented follow-up risks rather than review blockers.
2. [Completed] Carried forward the current validation record from the approved implementation because no new changes were made in this pass.

## Validation Evidence

- No new validation was run in this pass because no new changes were required after review approval.
- Latest recorded implementation validation remains green: `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- Latest recorded implementation validation remains green: `cargo test -p tank_data` passed with 41 tests green, including `presets::tests::test_process_preset_parser_migrates_legacy_nitrogen_param_meta_range_units`, `presets::tests::test_process_preset_parser_migrates_legacy_algae_half_saturation_param_meta_keys`, and `presets::tests::shipped_process_biomass_rate_controls_have_provenance_metadata`.
- Latest recorded implementation validation remains green: `cargo test -p tank_scenarios` passed across unit and integration suites, including `tests::process_preset_mapping_carries_denitrification_fields`.
- Latest recorded implementation validation remains green: `cargo test -p tank_core` passed across 102 unit tests and all integration suites; the run emitted one pre-existing unused-import warning in `tests/source_water_carbonate.rs`.
- Latest recorded review evidence also reported clean `clippy` across `tank_data`, `tank_scenarios`, and `tank_core`.

## Outstanding Risks

- `soft_acidic.toml` and `ro_like.toml` still do not carry per-parameter `param_meta` entries.
- Substrate provenance coverage is still partial beyond representative `colonizable_area_factor` annotations; other substrate indices and nutrient-charge fields remain unannotated.
- Code-resident carbonate constants still rely on doc comments plus `docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md` until the project adds a dedicated metadata registry for shared chemistry constants.
- The alkalinity budget unit-safety concern called out in the separate `.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7` worktree remains unresolved because it is outside this provenance-focused bead.
